title: proactive-fallback-trigger-scorer-and-circuit-actuator
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a scored trigger and actuation system to automatically initiate graceful fallback to alternative model variants or routing tiers when combined overload and error signals indicate reduced serving quality. Replace existing brittle threshold-only rules with a momentum-aware scorer that accounts for 429 rate spikes, p95/p99 latency drift, per-tenant error-rate, and decay primitives so we avoid oscillation and unnecessary fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: A scorer service ingests region/tier/model signals and emits a per-route integer score (0-100) every 30s
Circuit actuator consumes scores and transitions route state (closed->probation->open->recovery) according to defined hysteresis and decay parameters
When actuator opens, routing automatically shifts to configured fallback variant (regional tier or quantized model) with transparent routing reasons emitted to telemetry
No regressions in P95 tail for non-affected tenants during canary (<=2% delta), and controlled error-budget burn for the impacted routes
Feature gated behind runtime flag; rollout includes canary to 5% of requests, then 25%, then global over 72h with automatic rollback on quality regressions
design_notes: We propose a two-component approach: a lightweight scorer (stateless workers) that aggregates signals and computes a moving momentum score, and an actuator (stateful control-plane service) that manages route circuits and communicates fallback decisions to the router. Scores are computed per route+tenant+region and include: 429-rate delta, timeout-rate, p95 latency relative to baseline, model error-rate (response-level errors), and a compact abundance signal (burst size). Use exponential decay with configurable half-life to avoid thrash. Actuator implements soft-open (probation) with probe requests for recovery and backoff windows that double on repeated opens.
tasks: Spec scorer signal schema and proto (metrics keys, window sizes, decay constants)
Implement scorer worker in Go, expose gRPC read endpoint
Implement actuator state machine and REST admin endpoints
Integrate actuator with router to apply fallback routing decisions and annotate request trace headers
Add telemetry events: scorer.score, actuator.transition, fallback.apply, fallback.rollback
Create console dashboard: per-route score heatmap and recent actuator transitions
Write unit and e2e tests, chaos-run to simulate 429/timeouts spikes
Run 5% canary, collect metrics for 72h, iterate thresholds
telemetry_requirements: Emit scorer.score with fields: route, region, tenant, score, contributing_signals (list)
Tag traces with fallback.variant and fallback.reason for downstream debugging
Aggregate daily report: number of opens, average open-duration, percent requests affected
rollout_plan: Feature behind feature-flag. Deploy scorer and actuator to staging and run synthetic traffic for two days. Canary to 5% of traffic for 24h with alerting on: increased user-facing errors, >5% P95 regression for non-target tenants, sustained score > 70 in canary. If stable, expand to 25% for 48h, then to 100% over 72h. Include rollback playbook that disables actuator and reverts router annotation on failure.
risks_mitigation: Risk: Over-eager fallbacks causing unnecessary cost and quality degradation. Mitigation: conservative default scoring weights and probation probes before open.
Risk: Tenant isolation errors where one tenant's spikes influence another. Mitigation: per-tenant scoring and tenant caps on actuator decisions.
Risk: Telemetry volume increase. Mitigation: sampler for low-importance routes and aggregated counters instead of per-request events by default.
Risk: Oscillation between model variants. Mitigation: enforced minimal open duration and exponential backoff on repeated opens.
test_plan: Unit tests for score computation with synthetic signal sequences
Integration test: scorer->actuator->router flow with mocked router
E2E chaos test: inject 429 spikes and timeouts, assert fallback occurs and recovers per policy
Regression test: run existing routing benchmarks to verify no tail regressions for unaffected routes
comments: 2026-03-10 Ava Martinez: Initial spec posted. Wanted to avoid coupling actuator to tenant-level quotas; starting with per-tenant independent scoring.
2026-03-11 Priya Nambiar (SRE): Asked that scorer expose both raw signals and normalized score for post-hoc analysis; requested retention policy for score history.
2026-03-12 Design review: Agreed on soft-open probation of 60s with 10 probe requests at 5qps. Ethan to prototype actuator state machine this week.
2026-03-13 Security: audit logs must include actuator decisions and admin overrides. Security will review encryption-in-flight for scorer->actuator RPCs.
review_feedback: 2026-03-12 Michael O'Leary (Platform): Prefer keeping decay constants coarse-grained per-tenant class rather than per-tenant to reduce signal noise.
2026-03-12 Lina Svensson (PM): Add UI copy for Console to explain why fallback happened and link to suggested remediation steps.
2026-03-13 SRE: Suggest default alert thresholds: open_count > 3 in 10m OR average_score > 80 for 15m
